title: SUMIFS over a date range returns 0 because the imported dates are text

hook.body:
March totals zero.
The GL says otherwise.

payoff.headline:
Text dates don't
error. They zero out.
payoff.sub: DATEVALUE reads text in your regional date format.

script.vo: It's close night, March totals zero, and the GL says otherwise.
Three journal lines straight out of the GL export.
script.caption:
Three lines from the
GL export.

script.vo: SUMIFS over the amounts, March first through the end of the month.
script.caption:
SUMIFS across the
March date range.

script.vo: The range is right. The criteria are right.
script.caption:
Range is right.
Criteria are right.

script.vo: Those dates came in as text. SUMIFS is comparing them to a real date, and a text date never counts, so nothing gets added up.
script.caption:
Date tests skip
text dates.

script.vo: So convert them to real dates first. That's DATEVALUE. Just know it reads them in your regional date format.
script.caption:
Convert them first
with *DATEVALUE*.

script.vo: SUMIFS won't take a converted range, so SUMPRODUCT runs the same two checks.
script.caption:
Same checks, inside
SUMPRODUCT.

script.vo: There it is. March ties out.
script.caption: March ties out.

script.vo: Text dates don't fail loudly. They just total to zero.

post.title: SUMIFS returns 0 when imported dates are stored as text
post.description:
sumifs date range returns 0 excel
Dates that come in as text won't match a date test. Convert them with DATEVALUE and the total comes back. Save this for close.
